name: 3D Cube Projection and Rasterization
definition: A method to render a 3D cube by transforming its 8 vertices into 2D screen coordinates using perspective projection and drawing the visible faces (front, top, bottom) as polygons.
summary: 3D Cube Projection and Rasterization is a software rendering technique that transforms voxel cube vertices, applies perspective projection, and rasterizes visible faces as 2D polygons, differing from hardware rasterization by performing all depth testing in software.
